CONVERSATION.NAME: Get Justin to apologize to Stefanie
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: If Justin apologizes to Stefanie, she'll owe you - which just might mean she'll get Claire to stop standing in the way of your dating Justin.

CARD.NAME: Claire's whole personality changed because of this.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire's whole personality changed because of this. It really affected her.

CARD.NAME: Don't be morbid
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Thinking about dying is no way to live.

CARD.NAME: Help me out here.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Help me out here. Claire will keep making my life miserable.

CARD.NAME: I can't get to know you this way
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I can't get to know you with Claire on the warpath against me. And Stephanie can help call her off.

CARD.NAME: I care. Deal with it.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I care. Deal with it.

CARD.NAME: It wouldn mean a lot.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: It would mean a lot to a whole lot of people if you'd just apologize.

CARD.NAME: Love is the best medicine
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're worried about getting sick again? Love is the best medicine.

CARD.NAME: No excuses
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're using your past sickness as an excuse for hurting people - not cool.

CARD.NAME: Something to live for
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Doesn't having something - or someone special in your life make EVERYTHING better?

CARD.NAME: Stefanie deserves better.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stefanie used to be your friend. Doesn't she deserve better from you?

CARD.NAME: They're not over it.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You may think Claire and Stefanie are totally over it, but they're still hurt.

CARD.NAME: Why would you treat people like that?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: People love you. Why do you treat them badly?

CARD.NAME: Won't you do this for me?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Won't you do this for me? Please? (Gives a bonus to all guilt dialog)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of guilt,

CARD.NAME: You'll feel much better.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You'll feel much better with this off your conscience.

CARD.NAME: You're living in the past.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're living in the past. You have to move on.

CARD.NAME: Apologies are not my strong suit
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Apologies are not my strong suit. It would just come out sounding fake.

CARD.NAME: Claire's over me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire is so totally over me, so why does it even matter?

CARD.NAME: I did what I had to
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I did the best I could at the time.

CARD.NAME: I have a lot to deal with right now
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Look, I have a lot to deal with right now. I can't lose focus. Reduces all guilt dialog effects.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of guilt,

CARD.NAME: I have to save up all my energy.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I have to save up all my energy for this tournament. Don't distract me.

CARD.NAME: I haven't always been a nice guy.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I haven't always been a nice guy. Ask anyone.

CARD.NAME: I know I haven't always done the right thing
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I know I haven't always done the right thing, and that's kind of embarrassing to admit.

CARD.NAME: If you knew the things I'd done
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you knew the things I'd done, you might not like me very much.

CARD.NAME: It's ancient history.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: It's ancient history. Everyone's over it.

CARD.NAME: Leave me alone
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If people really cared, they'd just leave me the hell alone.

CARD.NAME: Maybe I just suck
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Maybe I just suck as a human being. Did you ever consider that?

CARD.NAME: Stephanie would never accept my apology
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stephanie would never accept my apology. Why should I even try?

CARD.NAME: Why bother?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Why should I bother with any of this? I'm just going to get sick again.

CARD.NAME: Why do you even care?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Why do you care so much about what happens to me?

CARD.NAME: You don't know what it's like being sick
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Unless you've been sick like me, you'll never know what I've gone through.
